title: Step 2a - Building Linear & Polynomial Regression Models in R: A Comparison

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: And now we are ready to move on to the next step, which is to fit our polynomial model to the dataset.
cues.zh: 現在已經可以進入下一步，將多項式模型擬合到資料集。

cues.en: However, I would like to show you how the polynomial regression model is a much more powerful model for our situation.
cues.zh: 不過，我想先展示在這個情境下，多項式迴歸模型為什麼更強大。

cues.en: And the best way to show you this is to actually compare it to a baseline model, like a reference base model, which will be our linear regression model.
cues.zh: 最好的方式就是和一個基準模型比較，也就是作為參考的模型；這裡使用線性迴歸。

cues.en: That's why in this tutorial we'll build two models, the linear regression model, and the polynomial regression model, and then we will compare the results, we will compare the graphic results
cues.zh: 因此這堂課要建立兩個模型：線性迴歸與多項式迴歸，然後比較結果，包括圖形結果

cues.en: and also the predictions, so you'll be convinced that the polynomial regression model is a much more appropriate model for this problem, and the main reason for that is
cues.zh: 與預測值。你就會相信，多項式迴歸更適合這個問題，而主要原因是

cues.en: that our problem is a non-linear problem.
cues.zh: 我們面對的是非線性問題。

cues.en: Okay, so let's start by building this linear model.
cues.zh: 好，先從建立線性模型開始。

cues.en: It's gonna be very quick, because we actually already did this.
cues.zh: 這會很快，因為先前其實已經做過了。

cues.en: So you know, we start by creating our regressor, that this time we're not gonna call regressor, because we will build two regressors, the linear one and the polynomial one.
cues.zh: 先建立迴歸器；這次不把它叫做 regressor，因為會建立兩個迴歸器，一個線性、一個多項式。

cues.en: So we will call it lin_reg.
cues.zh: 所以命名為 lin_reg。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: And then, you know, later we'll call our polynomial regressor poly_reg.
cues.zh: 稍後再把多項式迴歸器命名為 poly_reg。

cues.en: So lin_reg equals, and then remember we have to use the lm formula.
cues.zh: 輸入 lin_reg 等於，接著記得使用 lm 函式。

cues.en: And so we need to add some parenthesis here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡加上括號。

cues.en: And then let's remind ourselves what we need to input by pressing F1 here to have a look at the arguments.
cues.zh: 然後按 F1，看看參數，再提醒自己應該輸入什麼。

cues.en: Okay, so remember, the first argument is formula.
cues.zh: 記得，第一個參數是 formula。

cues.en: So the formula is very simply the Salary that is our independent variable, tilde, so I just pressed Alt + N,
cues.zh: 公式很簡單，以 Salary 這個依變數，接上波浪號；我剛按的是 Alt + N，

cues.en: and then a dot here to take all the independent variables, but actually there is only one independent variable.
cues.zh: 然後加上一個點，代表使用所有自變數。不過其實只有一個自變數。

cues.en: So the dot here is strictly equivalent as just writing Level.
cues.zh: 所以這個點完全等同於直接寫 Level。

cues.en: Okay, so perfect for the first argument.
cues.zh: 好，第一個參數完成。

cues.en: And then what is the second argument?
cues.zh: 第二個參數是什麼？

cues.en: It's data.
cues.zh: 是 data。

cues.en: So data, okay, so let's add this argument.
cues.zh: 好，加上 data 參數。

cues.en: Data equals, and now, let's see.
cues.zh: 輸入 data 等於，現在來看看。

cues.en: Okay, so in the linear regression section, we actually used the training set here as the data argument to train our linear regression model,
cues.zh: 在線性迴歸章節，我們使用訓練集作為 data 參數，訓練線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: But as we explained before, here we did not split the dataset into the training set or the test set, so we are simply going to train our model on the whole dataset itself,
cues.zh: 但先前解釋過，這裡沒有將資料集分成訓練集與測試集，所以直接用整份資料集訓練模型，

cues.en: because it's a small dataset anyway and we want to have the most accurate prediction.
cues.zh: 因為資料集本來就很小，而且我們想取得盡可能精準的預測。

cues.en: So here simply, we will just input dataset.
cues.zh: 所以這裡直接輸入 dataset。

cues.en: All right, and our linear regression model is ready.
cues.zh: 好，線性迴歸模型準備好了。

cues.en: We are actually ready to build it, so let's just do it.
cues.zh: 實際上已經可以建立了，現在就做吧。

cues.en: Let's build our linear regression model.
cues.zh: 來建立線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: I'm pressing Command and Control plus M to execute.
cues.zh: 我按 Command 或 Control 加 M 執行。

cues.en: All right, linear regression made.
cues.zh: 好了，線性迴歸模型建立完成。

cues.en: We can have a quick look at the summary here.
cues.zh: 可以快速查看一下摘要。

cues.en: Summary line_reg.
cues.zh: 使用 summary(lin_reg)。

cues.en: So I'm typing this in the console and pressing Enter.
cues.zh: 在主控台輸入，然後按 Enter。

cues.en: And here are the statistical results of the model.
cues.zh: 這裡就是模型的統計結果。

cues.en: We're doing this on R, because as you can see, it's really easy.
cues.zh: 在 R 裡很容易做到，如你所見。

cues.en: On Python, we would've needed to import a class, create an object, but here it's really easy.
cues.zh: 如果是 Python，需要匯入類別、建立物件；這裡則非常簡單。

cues.en: So we can have a look and we can see that the Level has two stars here for the level of significance, and is actually not a bad predictor of the salary.
cues.zh: 可以看到 Level 的顯著程度有兩顆星，其實已經是還不錯的薪資預測變數。

cues.en: But wait for the polynomial model to see how it's gonna be much better than linear regression.
cues.zh: 不過等看到多項式模型，就會知道它比線性迴歸更好。

cues.en: Okay, so now let's move on to the next level, that is the better model, polynomial regression, and let's build it.
cues.zh: 現在進入下一階段，建立更好的多項式迴歸模型。

cues.en: Okay, so as I mentioned, we're gonna call this regressor poly_reg, all right?
cues.zh: 如同剛才所說，將這個迴歸器命名為 poly_reg，好嗎？

cues.en: This way.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: And you know, since the polynomial regression model is actually a multiple linear regression model in which the independent variables are actually the polynomial features of one independent variables,
cues.zh: 多項式迴歸模型實際上是多元線性迴歸模型，其中的自變數，是某個自變數的多項式特徵，

cues.en: as Carol explained in the intuition tutorial.
cues.zh: 正如 Kirill 在直覺教學中所解釋的。

cues.en: Well, we are gonna use again the lm function as we did for linear regression.
cues.zh: 所以會再次使用 lm 函式，和線性迴歸時一樣。

cues.en: So here I'm just gonna start by taking my lm function, add the parenthesis, and we're gonna input our two arguments, formula equals Salary,
cues.zh: 先輸入 lm 函式，加上括號，再傳入兩個參數：formula 等於 Salary，

cues.en: tilde, Alt + N, and then this dot here.
cues.zh: 接著是波浪號，按 Alt + N，再加上這個點。

cues.en: But don't worry, we'll actually represent something else.
cues.zh: 別擔心，等等它實際上會代表其他內容。

cues.en: So, so far I'm just putting the dot and you'll understand what's gonna happen next, which will make our polynomial regression build correctly.
cues.zh: 目前先放上這個點，接下來你就會明白，如何讓多項式迴歸正確建立。

cues.en: So then comma, and then we add our second argument, which is still going to be the data equals dataset, because we're gonna train our polynomial regression model
cues.zh: 接著加上逗號與第二個參數，仍然是 data = dataset，因為要用

cues.en: on the whole dataset.
cues.zh: 整份資料集訓練多項式迴歸模型。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now you must be telling yourself, "Wait but this is exactly the same as linear regression."
cues.zh: 現在你一定在想：「等等，這不就和線性迴歸完全一樣嗎？」

cues.en: Well that's true and that's why we need to add a little something here to make this model a polynomial regression model.
cues.zh: 沒錯，所以還需要在這裡加上一點東西，才能讓它成為多項式迴歸模型。
